title: GeoSR equipment source archive
purpose: Reference-only archive of people-free equipment imagery exposed by official GeoSR equipment and technology pages.

rights.notice: Public availability on geosr.com does not grant reproduction, derivative-work, AI-reference, or publication rights. Obtain written permission from GeoSR and any third-party rightsholder before external or derivative use. Do not reproduce visible logos or text without permission.

inspection_method: For each listed official detail page, inspected its HTML img src, srcset, enclosing anchor href, onclick/lightbox attributes, and visible content image links. Archived only URLs actually exposed by the page. No guessed upload paths were tested.
people_hands_review: All eight archived assets were visually reviewed; no people or hands are visible. The six-frame USV GIF was reviewed frame by frame.

missing_sources.reason: The reviewed official equipment inventory did not expose an actual buoy/mooring equipment photo. The GeoSR license/IP page exposes patent-document thumbnails with buoy/mooring titles; these are documents, not photographs of physical equipment.
No official physical-equipment photograph or page-exposed exact TPRBM model source was identified in the reviewed GeoSR pages. Do not infer a model from patent scans or unrelated sensors.
